source_basis: The concept of big data has gained more and more attention these years with the development of information technology.
interpretation: The summary opens on a concept whose attention is rising, tied to the tool that drives it.
applicability: Reusable as the first sentence of a summary.
counterevidence: The driver named must be the one the paper relies on.

source_basis: In the era of data science, it is turning point determining companies to take the lead or be an underdog.
interpretation: The subject is raised to a fork with one good outcome and one bad one.
applicability: Reusable where the stakes need stating early.
counterevidence: Both outcomes must be plausible.

source_basis: This paper focuses on the measurement and also the improvement of the D&A system.
interpretation: The paper names two jobs rather than one.
applicability: Reusable when a paper has a dual aim.
counterevidence: Both jobs must be carried out.

source_basis: In Requirement 1, we first define several sub-indicators. Then we utilize a mapping function. Finally, we measure the maturity quantitatively.
interpretation: A whole requirement is compressed into three ordered beats.
applicability: Reusable for reporting several requirements in a summary.
counterevidence: The order must match the body.

source_basis: Eventually, we suggest protocols including five rules to evaluate the effectiveness.
interpretation: A requirement closes on the deliverable it produces, with the count stated.
applicability: Reusable at the end of a task report.
counterevidence: The count must be exact.

source_basis: With widespread application of equipments nowadays, comes increasing importance of data. However, most companies face great difficulty deriving value from it.
interpretation: The importance is granted and the difficulty is named in the next clause.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of a background.
counterevidence: The difficulty must be the one the model addresses.

source_basis: The most important components are people, technologies and process. Thus these three components and the connection between them must be taken into account.
interpretation: The model is committed to the components and to the links between them.
applicability: Reusable before an indicator system is built.
counterevidence: The model must actually use the links.

source_basis: In general, the departments in charge of the three components have different goals.
interpretation: Each part of the model is attached to a stakeholder with a distinct demand.
applicability: Reusable where a model serves several audiences.
counterevidence: Each demand must be addressed.

source_basis: Starting from the models for testing the difficulty of English texts, we will develop key performance indicators and use the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method.
interpretation: The plan is anchored in a prior model before the new work is named.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of an our-work section.
counterevidence: The seed model must be the one used.

source_basis: The portability of this model to other industries will be proved later.
interpretation: A claim is deferred to a named later section.
applicability: Reusable when a result cannot be shown yet.
counterevidence: The later section must deliver the claim.

source_basis: To build up our model, we make the following model assumptions.
interpretation: The assumption list is opened with one sentence and no preamble.
applicability: Reusable at the head of an assumption section.
counterevidence: The list must follow.

source_basis: The future state of the data queueing system only depends on the current state, and it is independent of past state.
interpretation: The memoryless property is stated in plain words before the queue is built.
applicability: Reusable before a memoryless model.
counterevidence: The model must be memoryless.

source_basis: Table 1 pairs each symbol with its definition in two columns.
interpretation: Every symbol is handed to one table.
applicability: Reusable for a notation section.
counterevidence: The table must be complete.

source_basis: In order to measure the D&A system maturity, the indicator selection is important.
interpretation: The section is justified by what is at stake before any indicator appears.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of an indicator section.
counterevidence: The choice must follow.

source_basis: For measuring the multi-workforce level, there is no formula but a self-rating questionnaire.
interpretation: An indicator that cannot be computed is marked as such, with its substitute named.
applicability: Reusable wherever an indicator lacks a formula.
counterevidence: The substitute must be described.

source_basis: We define proficiency as the total amount of completed work per month divided by the total time required.
interpretation: A name is bound to a ratio in one sentence.
applicability: Reusable before an indicator formula.
counterevidence: The formula must follow.

source_basis: The more experience a staff has, the better work he can achieve theoretically.
interpretation: The direction of an indicator is fixed before its formula.
applicability: Reusable when an indicator's direction is not obvious.
counterevidence: The mapping must respect the direction.

source_basis: If the downtime is short, the D&A system is more likely to be mature.
interpretation: A small value is tied to maturity, marking an indicator that should be penalized.
applicability: Reusable for an indicator that runs backwards.
counterevidence: The mapping must penalize the large value.

source_basis: Knowing how and where you are allocating your money is essential.
interpretation: An indicator is sold on the insight it gives rather than on a formula.
applicability: Reusable for a qualitative indicator.
counterevidence: The indicator must deliver the insight.

source_basis: We can not afford concrete expression for measuring the data masking level since data are not obtained. Therefore, ICM can test it on your own.
interpretation: An unmeasurable indicator is handed back to the reader with the reason stated.
applicability: Reusable when data are missing.
counterevidence: The reason must be stated.

source_basis: The factor sets can't be used to evaluate the maturity directly because of the monotonicity difference, which leads to a conflict.
interpretation: The mapping is motivated by a named conflict between indicator directions.
applicability: Reusable before a normalization step.
counterevidence: The mapping must resolve the conflict.

source_basis: Generally, we set three kinds of mapping functions, including the hyperbolic tangent, exponential, and itself.
interpretation: A case split is announced with its count before any case is used.
applicability: Reusable before a family of transformations.
counterevidence: Every announced case must be used.

source_basis: If the increase of an indicator promotes the maturity, it then undergoes the map with the hyperbolic tangent function.
interpretation: Each indicator is routed to its map by its direction.
applicability: Reusable inside a case split.
counterevidence: The function must match the direction.

source_basis: Suppose that according to the experts' experience and knowledge, we have the judgement matrix.
interpretation: The matrix is attributed to experts rather than to data.
applicability: Reusable before an expert-derived matrix.
counterevidence: The matrix must be shown or its absence conceded.

source_basis: It is worth noting that the elements of the matrix satisfy the diagonal being one and every entry positive.
interpretation: A property the method needs is flagged explicitly.
applicability: Reusable when a method depends on a structural property.
counterevidence: The property must hold.

source_basis: If the consistency ratio satisfy CR less than 0.1, the matrix is acceptable. Otherwise, the judgement matrix needs to be modified.
interpretation: The test is closed with both the pass branch and the fail branch.
applicability: Reusable after any acceptance test.
counterevidence: The failure branch must be kept.

source_basis: To amplify the effect of scoring, we time all the mapped values by 100, which ensures each indicator score is in the range from 0 to 100.
interpretation: A rescaling is justified by readability and its range is stated.
applicability: Reusable before a change of scale.
counterevidence: The range must follow from the factor.

source_basis: To better describe the maturity, we divide the total score 100 into five equal intervals.
interpretation: A continuous score is cut into named levels.
applicability: Reusable at the end of a scoring section.
counterevidence: The bands must cover the range.

source_basis: To recommend changes according to the evaluation results, we need to know what key performance indicators need to be improved first.
interpretation: The advice is reduced to a priority question before any recommendation.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of a suggestions section.
counterevidence: A ranking must follow.

source_basis: As is known, the increase of one indicator can influence another, which is called causal relationship in our model.
interpretation: A relationship is named before the network is built on it.
applicability: Reusable before a network model.
counterevidence: The name must be used afterwards.

source_basis: The algorithm flow is as follows.
interpretation: A procedure is handed to a bulleted list in one sentence.
applicability: Reusable before an algorithm listing.
counterevidence: The list must be the algorithm.

source_basis: The key performance indicator with a large PR value can be first improved.
interpretation: The ranking is converted into an action.
applicability: Reusable at the end of a ranking section.
counterevidence: The value must be the computed one.

source_basis: As hiring managers proposes many questions, we provide our suggestions from different perspectives extracted from those questions.
interpretation: Advice is structured as answers to a named stakeholder's questions.
applicability: Reusable in a recommendations section.
counterevidence: Each answer must name its indicator.

source_basis: Satisfying at least one of the following conditions, choose hiring.
interpretation: A decision is given as a list of sufficient conditions.
applicability: Reusable wherever advice should be checkable.
counterevidence: The conditions must be listed.

source_basis: Therefore, it is wise to increase when the proficiency is low and the income of the cooperation is enough to function well.
interpretation: A recommendation is qualified by both of its conditions.
applicability: Reusable for conditional advice.
counterevidence: Every condition must be stated.

source_basis: When other factors have no room for improvement, it's time to look for more products to use.
interpretation: The improvements are ordered, with a checkable precondition.
applicability: Reusable when advice has a sequence.
counterevidence: The precondition must be checkable.

source_basis: To suggest protocols measuring the effectiveness, we first develop two models to give a sensible method. Then we propose protocols.
interpretation: The rules are kept downstream of the models that support them.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of a protocol section.
counterevidence: The rules must use the models.

source_basis: This data transmission process can be taken as a queueing system where data are customers, the system is the server.
interpretation: A process is translated into a known model by an explicit mapping of roles.
applicability: Reusable when importing a standard model.
counterevidence: Every role must be assigned.

source_basis: Data input process is taken as a Poisson process appropriately since the occurence of data input is natural and random on a large time scale.
interpretation: A distributional assumption is defended by a reason.
applicability: Reusable before a stochastic assumption.
counterevidence: The reason must support the distribution.

source_basis: It is intuitive that the data transmission process obeys the rule that first comes, first to be recorded and processed.
interpretation: A service discipline is settled as obvious in one sentence.
applicability: Reusable for a modelling choice that needs no argument.
counterevidence: The rule must be the one modelled.

source_basis: We obtain by equating the data volume from n minus 1 to n and from n to n minus 1 that the balance holds.
interpretation: A balance equation is derived from a verbal principle before the formula.
applicability: Reusable before a balance equation.
counterevidence: The formula must match the words.

source_basis: We can see that the expectation of data volume in the system depends on data input rate and output rate.
interpretation: The dependence is read off a finished formula.
applicability: Reusable after a derivation.
counterevidence: The factors must be the ones in the formula.

source_basis: In this way, protocols can be established for measuring the effectiveness based on the expression we get.
interpretation: A derivation is connected to the protocol it enables.
applicability: Reusable at the end of a derivation.
counterevidence: The protocol must use the expression.

source_basis: When it comes to the effectiveness of the system, data cascade is a crucial point for any data system.
interpretation: One aspect is promoted to the decisive one, justifying a new model.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of a model section.
counterevidence: The aspect must be modelled.

source_basis: The edges indicate a cascade between two data, thus we utilize the network average degree as a metric to quantify the cascade level.
interpretation: A network statistic is chosen as a proxy and the choice is justified.
applicability: Reusable when a quantity is measured indirectly.
counterevidence: The statistic must track the meaning.

source_basis: We assume that rates of data transiting through computer software are the same, then the number of hops play an important role.
interpretation: Several rates are collapsed into one and what remains is elevated.
applicability: Reusable when a model is reduced.
counterevidence: The dropped variables must be named.

source_basis: The following protocols provide effectiveness measurement both qualitatively and quantitatively.
interpretation: The protocol promises both a label and a number.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of a grading scheme.
counterevidence: Both must be delivered.

source_basis: If 60% to 80%, the system is ordinarily effective. If above 90, it is super effective. Otherwise, it is ineffective.
interpretation: A percentage is graded into named bands with a catch-all for the rest.
applicability: Reusable at the end of a scoring protocol.
counterevidence: The bands must meet.

source_basis: For a better presentation, we compare them in the radar chart.
interpretation: A table is restated as a chart for readability.
applicability: Reusable when numbers are shown twice.
counterevidence: The chart must show the same numbers.

source_basis: The multi-workforce, the number of products, and the maintenance rate get the lowest points respectively.
interpretation: The weakest indicator in each group is named.
applicability: Reusable after a grouped scoring.
counterevidence: The count must match the groups.

source_basis: The final maturity score is 82.734. Therefore, according to the table, this system can be considered optimizing.
interpretation: A computed score is placed on the named scale.
applicability: Reusable after a scoring result.
counterevidence: The level must be the band that contains the value.

source_basis: By adding the indicators based on the customers' type, the proposed model can be easily extended and be applied to different kinds of costumers.
interpretation: Transfer is claimed through the addition of indicators.
applicability: Reusable in a generalization section.
counterevidence: The added indicators must be specified.

source_basis: As is known to all, changing or building up a new metric is a high cost work. If costumers' utility cannot make up for the expenses, they won't use this metric.
interpretation: The adoption threshold is stated before the dynamics.
applicability: Reusable before a benefit-cost model.
counterevidence: The model must use the threshold.

source_basis: Apparently, if the utility is below the cost, the costumers prefer not to use the metric. But if the utility is above the cost, the costumers may use this metric.
interpretation: Both sides of the threshold are read.
applicability: Reusable after a threshold result.
counterevidence: Both cases must be analyzed.

source_basis: Obviously, when the utility exceeds the cost, the benefit goes higher. However, the benefit increases faster with a low cost. Therefore, according to our model, the corporation obtains a high benefit.
interpretation: A figure is read into a recommendation in three steps.
applicability: Reusable at the end of a results section.
counterevidence: The conclusion must follow the plot.

source_basis: The method provides both an elicitation method as well as a strong theoretical framework. Instead of asking experts to directly give a weight, they rate the relative importance.
interpretation: A method is credited with two virtues and set against its crude alternative.
applicability: Reusable in a strengths section.
counterevidence: Both virtues must be real.

source_basis: The model has strong portability. To use our model in the system of other industries, most key performance indicators that we presume can be maintained.
interpretation: Portability is grounded in what survives unchanged.
applicability: Reusable when arguing transfer.
counterevidence: The kept indicators must be named.

source_basis: The method can only find the best solution from existing solutions and can not provide new solutions.
interpretation: A method is bounded by the job it cannot do.
applicability: Reusable in a weaknesses section.
counterevidence: The missing job must be real.

source_basis: The input rate and output rate could be time-varying in the real society, which leads to a nonhomogeneous Markov chain. In this situation, the protocols are hard to determine.
interpretation: An assumption is conceded as the point where reality may break the result.
applicability: Reusable in a limitations section.
counterevidence: The assumption must be one the model makes.

source_basis: Our team is hired by the cooperation to measure the maturity level. It is pleasant to tell you that you have made a wise decision since the results take on a high-level maturity.
interpretation: The letter opens with the commission and delivers the verdict immediately.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of a letter.
counterevidence: The verdict must match the result.

source_basis: We next outline our model to let you know further about the conditions of the corporation's system.
interpretation: The reader is promised a guided tour of the model.
applicability: Reusable between the verdict and the explanation.
counterevidence: The outline must follow.

source_basis: In addition to the system maturity level, we also propose protocols to measure its effectiveness.
interpretation: The second deliverable is kept from being lost.
applicability: Reusable when a letter carries two results.
counterevidence: Both deliverables must exist.

source_basis: The corporation possesses an integrated, mature, and efficient system. The corporation is still trying to keep optimizing its system.
interpretation: The letter closes by praising and noting that the effort continues.
applicability: Reusable at the end of a letter.
counterevidence: The effort must be real.

source_basis: Ten of the sixteen sub-indicators are explicit ratios; proficiency is work per time, turnover is the leaving share, accuracy is one minus the faulty share.
interpretation: The indicator layer is computable once the counts are known.
applicability: Reusable as a template for a maturity indicator set.
counterevidence: Four indicators have no formula at all.

source_basis: Three maps are declared and each indicator is assigned to one by its direction.
interpretation: The direction conflict is handled before the weighting rather than inside it.
applicability: Reusable for any score mixing opposite-direction indicators.
counterevidence: The exponential map is increasing, so it rewards what it should penalize.

source_basis: The maturity is the group scores combined with the group weights, claimed to lie in [0, 100].
interpretation: Two layers keep the group comparison separate from the indicator comparison.
applicability: Reusable for a hierarchical score.
counterevidence: The range claim fails for the exponential map.

source_basis: A damped PageRank on the sixteen-node causal network ranks the indicators.
interpretation: The advice is turned into an order rather than a list.
applicability: Reusable wherever improvements must be sequenced.
counterevidence: No rank is ever computed.

source_basis: The expected number in the system equals the arrival rate divided by the service rate.
interpretation: The capacity rule depends on exactly two rates.
applicability: Reusable as the capacity measure in a protocol.
counterevidence: Equation (48) prints the distribution with the wrong sign.

source_basis: The adopter share grows exactly when the benefit exceeds the cost, since the factor (alpha - beta) fixes the sign.
interpretation: The adoption threshold falls directly out of the equation.
applicability: Reusable for a benefit-cost adoption model.
counterevidence: The realized benefit is defined as alpha times the share, so it grows with adoption.

source_basis: The mapping section exists only because the raw indicators point in different directions.
interpretation: The transformation is derived from a stated conflict rather than applied by habit.
applicability: Reusable as the justification for any normalization.
counterevidence: The chosen exponential map does not fix the conflict.

source_basis: The suggestions are withheld until the question of what to improve first has been posed.
interpretation: Priority is made a precondition of advice.
applicability: Reusable before a recommendations section.
counterevidence: The advice in section 4.2 is not actually ordered by the computed rank.

source_basis: The protocol rules are introduced only after the two models that support them.
interpretation: The rules stay downstream of their evidence.
applicability: Reusable wherever a protocol follows a model.
counterevidence: The processing-speed rule does not use the distribution the queue derived.

source_basis: Each weakness names the job the method cannot do or the assumption reality may break.
interpretation: The limits are stated as boundaries rather than as apologies.
applicability: Reusable in a weaknesses section.
counterevidence: None.

source_basis: Figure 3 draws the sixteen indicators as a network coloured green, red and blue by group.
interpretation: The grouping and the causal links are visible at once.
applicability: Reusable as the figure that justifies the ranking.
counterevidence: The figure shows no computed rank.

source_basis: Figure 9 restates the three group scores as radar charts, and the prose names the lowest point on each.
interpretation: The chart makes the bottleneck of each group readable.
applicability: Reusable after a grouped scoring table.
counterevidence: The chart was not inspected on the raster; the reading rests on the prose.

source_basis: Figure 10 plots the realized benefit for three benefits and three costs.
interpretation: The figure is the only support offered for the adoption claim.
applicability: Reusable as the evidence behind a threshold conclusion.
counterevidence: The curves use chosen parameters, not observed adoption.

source_basis: A judgement matrix is accepted only when its consistency ratio stays under 0.1, and the failure branch demands a revision.
interpretation: The weights have a stated acceptance rule.
applicability: Reusable after any pairwise comparison matrix.
counterevidence: No ratio is computed in the paper.

source_basis: Equation (49) recovers the known mean of an M/M/infinity queue.
interpretation: The derivation can be checked against a standard result.
applicability: Reusable as a sanity check on a queueing model.
counterevidence: The check passes only after the sign in equation (48) is corrected.

source_basis: The replicator algebra simplifies correctly to x(1-x)(alpha-beta).
interpretation: The dynamics can be verified by expanding the brackets.
applicability: Reusable as a check on a copied equation.
counterevidence: The algebra being correct says nothing about the payoff definition.

source_basis: The demonstration scores a system whose data were generated randomly.
interpretation: The reported maturity rests on synthetic input.
applicability: Reusable as a caveat on any demonstration result.
counterevidence: None.

source_basis: The people weights sum to 1.000 while the technology and process weights each sum to 1.002.
interpretation: The reported weights are close to but not exactly a distribution.
applicability: Reusable when checking a printed weight table.
counterevidence: The excess could be rounding.

source_basis: Five assumptions are listed and none is justified.
interpretation: The model states what it rests on but not why.
applicability: Reusable as a warning about bare assumption lists.
counterevidence: The memoryless assumption is at least restated in words.

source_basis: Every customer is given the same benefit and the same cost.
interpretation: The replicator threshold depends on customers being identical.
applicability: Reusable before generalizing an adoption result.
counterevidence: The weakness section concedes that real customers differ.

source_basis: The maturity is 82.734, which falls in the Optimizing band covering [80, 100].
interpretation: The number selects its own band.
applicability: Reusable as the headline result.
counterevidence: The input data are random.

source_basis: The group scores are 88.240 for people, 67.920 for technology and 86.535 for process.
interpretation: Technology is the weak group.
applicability: Reusable when reporting a layered score.
counterevidence: The row labels of the supporting table are shifted.

source_basis: The benefit climbs fastest when the benefit is high and the cost is low.
interpretation: The recommendation is to clear the cost and then cut it.
applicability: Reusable as a threshold conclusion.
counterevidence: The curves are not calibrated to data.

source_basis: Equation (15) applies an increasing exponential to indicators whose rise should lower maturity.
interpretation: The map rewards the indicators it was introduced to penalize.
applicability: A warning against choosing a map by name rather than by direction.
counterevidence: The hyperbolic tangent cases are assigned correctly.

source_basis: Equations (29) to (31) print the normalizing sums with the upper limit below the lower limit.
interpretation: The printed normalization cannot be evaluated as written.
applicability: A warning to check summation limits on the raster.
counterevidence: Equation (24) prints the same normalization correctly.

source_basis: Table 2 gives a matrix of order ten a random index of 0.49, below the value for order nine.
interpretation: The reference table is not monotone in the matrix order.
applicability: A warning to check copied reference tables.
counterevidence: The orders the paper actually uses, three to six, carry plausible values.

source_basis: Equation (48) prints the stationary probability with a positive exponential, while equation (47) requires a negative one.
interpretation: The distribution contradicts the normalization it was derived from.
applicability: A warning to check signs across a derivation.
counterevidence: Equation (49) gives the correct mean.

source_basis: Equation (50) calls the cascade level an average but omits the division by the number of networks.
interpretation: The formula does not compute what the prose says it computes.
applicability: A warning to match a formula against its verbal description.
counterevidence: The per-network term is itself an average degree.

source_basis: The processing-speed rule uses C factorial instead of n factorial, and the general effectiveness averages raw quantities while claiming the range [0, 1].
interpretation: The protocol grade is not the probability it claims to be, and its scale is inconsistent.
applicability: A warning against mixing raw values and percentages in one average.
counterevidence: The four named bands are at least ordered.

source_basis: The reference list holds three entries: two web pages and the 1999 PageRank report.
interpretation: The ranking method is the only model with a scholarly source.
applicability: Reusable as a note on thin citation.
counterevidence: The queueing and replicator results are standard and could have been cited.
